Contempt Proceedings Against The
Respondent/ Accused Herein And To Punish Him
In Accordance With Law For Having Disobeyed
The Order Dated 17.02.2021, Passed By Learned
Single Judge Of This Hon'Ble Court In
W.P.No.205210/2019, In The Interest Of Justice
And Equity.

This Petition Coming On For Orders This
Day, B.M. Shyam Prasad J., Made The Following:
 Order

The complainant, who is the petitioner in W.P.No.205210/2019 which is disposed of on 17.02.2021,
alleges that there is deliberate disobedience with the NC: 2023:KHC-K:931-DB following directions which is part of the order dated 17.02.2021.
"In view of the above facts, the writ petition is allowed.

mandamus is issued directing respondent No.4 to conduct proper survey, measure the land taken possession of and consider the representation of the petitioner dated 05.01.2017 in accordance with law within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order."

On the previous occasion, Sri. A.M.Nagaral, the learned counsel who is permitted to appear for the first respondent, had submitted that the present Commissioner could ascertain that the petitioners representation has been considered and a survey is conducted in accordance with law.

Presently, Sri.
A.M.Nagaral, relying upon certain documents produced along with the memo, submits that not only is the survey completed by the concerned, a proposal is sent for payment of compensation because it is NC: 2023:KHC-K:931-DB ascertained that an extent of about 84 square feet is utilized without acquisition.

2 These submissions are taken on record and the proceeding stands dropped with liberty to the complainant to pursue remedy if there is failure to pay compensation as now stated before this Court.
